summary: P-07B drive-end bearing vibration reached 7.9 mm/s after coupling misalignment. Alignment and regreasing are done and a test run passed at 2.4 mm/s. Return the pump to service with the revised drive and alarm settings.

steps.instruction: Confirm LOTO tag #4471 has been removed by an authorised technician.
Return P-07B to duty/standby rotation with P-07A as lead pump.
Log the first 24 h vibration trend for upload at the next maintenance window.
